thread:
morgan: PTAL on PR #4827 — addressed the review comments from earlier, fixed the null-checks, and added a small unit test. CI is rerunning now. I left a note on the `CacheManager` change.
jamie: Thanks — quick question: did you keep the previous timeout behavior for warmup requests? I remember that caused a regression before.
morgan: Good catch. I restored the original timeout for warmup flows. Diff snippet: `if (warmup) timeoutMs = Math.max(timeoutMs, 3000);` — added a test that simulates a slow backend.
ravi: Can you push a commit that bumps the package-lock? CI is failing on the flaky test environment sometimes.
morgan: Pushed commit 7f3a2b3 that updates lockfile and pins jest to 29.4.1. Also added retry in the flaky test, it's now using `await eventually(() => expect(...), 2000)`.
ci-bot: Build started for commit 7f3a2b3 (PR #4827). Running unit tests.
tessa: @jamie I can do a quick pass after CI passes if you want an extra set of eyes.
jamie: That would be great. If CI is green and tessa + I approve we can merge before the end of day. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: All checks passed for commit 7f3a2b3 — unit tests 142/142, lint ok.
morgan: PTAL again when you have a sec — this unblocks the batching refactor branch that needs the preserved timeout semantics. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4827
jamie: Reviewing now.
jamie: Looks good to me, small nit about a log msg text but not blocking. Approving.
tessa: Approved. No functional concerns.
morgan: Thanks both! I'll merge after a short wait to let any late comments show up. :shipit:
